purpose: Teach: 防護/寄生虫/万引き/罵倒/国策/保釈/喚問/殺傷

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、現場で防護服を着用されてますね
lines.en: The police are wearing protective suits at the scene in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly uncertain. Gentle upward lilt at the end—genuinely asking for confirmation. Respectful distance. Curious but not probing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、寄生虫を媒介とした事案にも対応します
lines.en: The police handle cases involving parasitic vectors in our response protocols.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. Precise articulation. Professional distance maintained. Calm, authoritative without urgency.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、万引き常習者を警察、特定されてますね
lines.en: I understand the police have identified a habitual shoplifter in this case, correct?
lines.style: Careful, respectful phrasing. Slight pause before the question—thinking it through. Deferential tone. Seeking confirmation without assumption.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者への罵倒行為を厳しく取り締まります
lines.en: The police are taking a strict stance against verbal abuse directed at victims in incidents like these.
lines.style: Firm conviction without aggression. Clear, decisive articulation. Weight on 'strict.' Professional authority. Not negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、国策事業に関連する不正を警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: I believe the police are investigating irregularities connected to national policy initiatives in this case?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly deferential phrasing. Hesitant—aware of sensitivity. Soft inquiry. Respectful distance. Waiting for affirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の保釈条件を厳格に管理します
lines.en: The police maintain rigorous oversight of bail conditions for suspects to prevent re-offense.
lines.style: Precise, controlled delivery. Even pace. Clinical but not cold. Emphasize 'rigorous'—this is non-negotiable protocol.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、国会喚問への対応を警察、ご支援されてますね
lines.en: The police are providing support in preparation for the Diet questioning in this matter, aren't they?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity. Respectful acknowledgment of complexity. Soft rise at the end—sincere question, not assumption. Thoughtful spacing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、無差別殺傷事件に総力で対応します
lines.en: The police are mobilizing all available resources to respond to indiscriminate violence incidents.
lines.style: Grave, serious tone. Measured but weighted. Controlled intensity. Close, direct eye contact level. No hedging. Absolute commitment.
